title: HB93 (2025 Regular): AN ACT relating to target shooting.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/25RS/hb93/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3041322))
provenance.note: Introduced version (25 RS BR 189); later amendments not in text read. No votes recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (2) A person shall not target shoot carelessly, recklessly, or without regard for the safety of any person, or in a manner that endangers or is likely to endanger any person, pet, livestock, wildlife, or property. (3) It shall not be a violation of subsection (2) of this section if a person participates in target shooting: (a) At a recreation facility designed for target shooting; or (b) In an area with an unobstructed, earthen backstop capable of stopping all projectiles and debris in a safe manner. (4) Any person who violates this section shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.
